_schema.description: Tare-weight lookup for containers the vision model will classify. Unit: pounds. The workflow's 'Apply container tare' node matches detected container_type against keys here and subtracts the tare from the model's weight estimate to report net food weight.
_schema.how_to_extend: Add more entries as new containers show up. `keywords` are lowercase substrings that the vision model's `item_type` or `notes` fields are matched against. First match wins. Keep the keywords generic enough that gpt-4o-mini will naturally use them.
_schema.confidence: seed values are rough — refine with a kitchen scale as the team encounters each container type
